en.headline: Hong Kong economy grows 5.2% in third quarter, fastest nine-month pace in five years
en.dek: Advance estimates show real GDP up 5.2% year on year in Q3 and 1.9% on a seasonally adjusted basis, driven by exports and domestic demand.
body: The Census and Statistics Department said on Tuesday that Hong Kong's real gross domestic product increased by 5.2% in the third quarter of 2026 compared with a year earlier, according to advance estimates. That followed 4.2% growth in the second quarter and marked the 15th consecutive quarter of expansion.

On a seasonally adjusted quarter-to-quarter basis, GDP rose 1.9% in the third quarter. For the first three quarters of 2026 combined, real GDP grew 5.1% over a year earlier, the fastest pace for that period in five years.

Private consumption expenditure rose 2.8% in real terms, government consumption increased 1.7% after being virtually unchanged in the previous quarter, and gross domestic fixed capital formation climbed 7.3%. Total exports of goods surged 30.4%, while imports of goods rose 29.9%. Exports of services grew 4.3% and imports of services 5.6%.

A government spokesman said the economy expanded robustly, underpinned by accelerating growth in exports and solid domestic demand. Looking ahead, the outlook remains positive, supported by global artificial intelligence investment, inbound tourism, cross-boundary traffic and financial market activity, though geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and tighter monetary policies by major central banks warrant close monitoring.
Revised GDP figures and more detailed statistics for the third quarter, along with the revised forecast for 2026, will be released on 13 November.

zh.headline: 本港第三季經濟預估按年增長5.2% 首三季增速創五年最快
zh.dek: 預先估計數字顯示實質本地生產總值按年升5.2%，經季節調整後按季升1.9%，由出口及內部需求帶動。
body: 政府統計處周二公布，根據預先估計數字，本港2026年第三季實質本地生產總值較上年同期上升5.2%，較第二季4.2%的升幅加快，並錄得連續第15季擴張。
經季節性調整後按季比較，第三季實質本地生產總值上升1.9%。今年首三季合計，實質本地生產總值按年增長5.1%，是五年來同期最快的增長。
私人消費開支實質上升2.8%，政府消費開支在第二季大致不變後第三季上升1.7%，本地固定資本形成總額上升7.3%。貨品出口總額實質大幅增加30.4%，貨品進口上升29.9%。服務輸出上升4.3%，服務輸入上升5.6%。
政府發言人表示，經濟在第三季強勁擴張，由出口增長加快及內部需求穩健支持。展望未來，前景維持正面，全球人工智能投資、入境旅遊、跨境交通及金融市場活動將繼續提供支持，惟中東地緣政治緊張及主要央行收緊貨幣政策等外部不確定因素值得密切留意。
第三季經修訂本地生產總值數字及更詳細統計，以及2026年經修訂預測，將於11月13日公布。
